meta.purpose: Definitive machine-actionable guide to eliminating visible 'AI-Slop' and generic mid-AI design tropes from TOAD DSL and visual generation.
meta.core_premise: AI models regress toward the statistical average of their training data (the 'Mid-AI Mean'). Authentic, human-grade design requires deliberate tension, domain-specific craft, informational density, and strict avoidance of synthetic clichés.
meta.golden_rule: LESS IS MORE: The most severe malfunction of generative models is 'Horror Vacui' (the compulsive fear of empty space). AI reflexively packs every free pixel with redundant badges, tiles, mini-icons, decorative rules, and glows. True visual mastery, elegance, and professional command emerge only through radical courage to embrace empty space, disciplined negative space, and deliberate omission of the superfluous.

universal_scope.mandate: FUNDAMENTAL & UNIVERSAL VALIDITY ACROSS ALL FORMATS
universal_scope.rule: The Anti-AI-Slop rules apply without exception to EVERY design brief — whether business card, social media post, A1 print poster, rollup banner, logo, icon, magazine cover, technical diagram, mobile screen, or web dashboard.
There are NO domain exemptions. A poster must never be cluttered with senseless decorative debris or purple haze any more than a dashboard or flyer.

axiom.title: LESS IS MORE (Radical Negative Space & Horror Vacui Ban)
axiom.statement: Universally applies to posters, banners, logos, cards, UIs, and print media: At least 40% to 60% of the canvas area must be calm, deliberate negative space. Jamming corners with mini-badges, decorative dots, or auxiliary cards is strictly prohibited.

axiom.title: NO FLOATING DECORATIVE DEBRIS (Floating Debris Ban)
axiom.statement: Universally applies to social assets, posters, UIs, and banners: No unanchored floating crosses (+), confetti dots, wireframe toruses, chrome donuts, or purposeless geometric floating debris. Every rendered element must fulfill a tangible communicative or layout function.

axiom.title: NO DIFFUSE COLOR MIST (Purple Haze & Blind Blur Ban)
axiom.statement: Universally applies: No diffuse, unfocused radial color blur circles (magenta/cyan) behind copy or objects without a physically visible light source. Illumination must be defined as an edge reflex, directional spotlight, or architectural surface.

axiom.title: TYPOGRAPHIC COMMAND & MANDATORY FLUSH-LEFT BODY
axiom.statement: Universally applies: Body prose longer than 2 lines MUST always be left-aligned (align: left;) — never centered! Uppercase text (ALL CAPS) MUST always be tracked (letter-spacing: 0.08em; to 0.15em;). Never mindlessly deploy Inter or Roboto as an unthinking panacea.

axiom.title: SOLID SURFACES OVER GLASS OVERDOSE & SOAP-BAR RADII
axiom.statement: Universally applies: No blanket conversion of all surfaces into milky glassmorphism slabs with 32px soap-bar corner radii. Solid, opaque surfaces with disciplined 6px–12px radii (or crisp 0px–2px for editorial/FinTech) form the backbone of credible aesthetics.

axiom.title: THE MONOCHROME 1-BIT TEST (Substance Over Gimmickry)
axiom.statement: Universally applies to logos, icons, vector graphics, and layouts: The design must remain strong and unmistakably legible as a pure 1-bit silhouette (100% black on 100% white). Any design that collapses without gradients, drop shadows, or blur is inherently flawed.

axiom.title: NO BUZZWORD CLICHÉS & HOLLOW PLATITUDES
axiom.statement: Universally applies to print, web, social media, and B2B assets: Ban on 'Supercharge', 'Seamless', 'Next-Gen'. Always deploy concrete, domain-specific terminology, real tools, verifiable metrics, and unambiguous statements.

category.title: K.O. Criteria (Immediate Proof of Unsanitized AI Slop)
category.criterion: Dense Node Clustering: Hundreds of disorganized anchor points per curve; wobbly zigzag contours (Ctrl+Y outline view).
Glyph Morphing & Pseudoglyphs: Deformed counters on 'e'/'a'/'o', faux-lettering, erratic stem stroke weights.
Mock Interactivity: Snapping states without easing transitions, dead href='#' links, unhydrated empty mock states.
Melting Outlines & Plane Fusion: Vector or ink outlines diffusely dissolving into background shading surfaces.
Systemic Inconsistency: Erratically shifting stroke weights (1px vs 3.5px) and mixed projections (2D flat alongside 3D isometric).
Baked Transparency Fallacy: Burned-in gray-and-white Photoshop checkerboard painted directly into pixel bitmaps.
Tiling Defects: Visible seam artifacts or brightness drift jumps in 3x3 repetition testing.
Topological Ribbon Collapse: Scrolls and ribbons merging front and back sides without folding creases.

category.title: Heavy Suspicion (Requires Manual Revision & Design Provenance Proof)
category.criterion: Functional Legibility Collapse: Illegible at 16x16px (favicon test); contrast destruction in 1-bit monochrome test.
Topological Impossibility: Contradictory 3D ribbon intersections and pseudo-geometric loop knots.
Vibe-Coding Archetype: Unmotivated 3-4px color accent bar along left card edge combined with Tailwind monoculture (p-6, rounded-2xl).
Hero Stencil: Cyan-violet text gradient, unmotivated italic serif collision mid-sentence, diffuse glowing spheres in background.
Token Inconsistency: Erratic padding and spacing values violating 8pt modular grid; responsive layout wrapping breakages.
Accidental Tangencies: Contours across different depth planes grazing each other point-to-point, flattening depth.
Purposeless Greebling: Superficial mechanical greebles devoid of physical or functional logic.

principle.name: Separation of Decorative Presentation from Native Construction
principle.rule: Design work must never be evaluated solely via isolated 3D perspective mockups or static rendered presentations, as these artifacts disguise structural defects.
Audits MUST be executed directly on raw source assets: Unflattened vector paths (outline mode), editable typography, and native TOAD DSL code.

principle.name: System Integrity as the Primary Quality Metric
principle.rule: Professional design caliber is demonstrated not by an isolated hero shot, but by consistent, disciplined scaling across the entire design system.
Proof through stress tests: Does the brandmark survive 16x16px favicon and 1-bit print tests? Are stroke weights unified across dozens of icons? Does the layout conform strictly to an 8pt token grid?

principle.name: Traceability of Design Construction (Design Provenance)
principle.rule: Professional design leaves a verifiable construction trail: Named layer hierarchies, clean component tokens, modular type scales, and justified structural decisions.
If these traces are absent and only flattened bitmaps or auto-traced path fragments exist, the K.O. criteria of this catalog apply immediately.
